d:
Bangladesh ke pradhanmantri tariq rahman ne purv pradhanmantri shekh hasina ki avami lig par bangladesh ko asthir karne ki sazish rachne ka aarop lagaya hai. hasina ki parti ki or se deshbhar men ek din ke band ke aahvan ke bad kuchh ilakon men hinsa huee. bibisi bangla ke mutabiq, budhvar ko narail men virodh pradarshan se lautte samay hue hamle men bienpi ke do netaon ki hatya kar di gaee. pulis ka kahna hai ki hamlavar pratibandhit avami lig ke neta aur karyakarta the.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
